event:
I withdrew the finding. The sequence never reads WKUP_COUNT, as the finding says. But the check isn't in the sequence. The scoreboard works out the expected wakeup time as `(wkup_thold - wkup_count) * (prescaler + 1)` and checks the interrupt against it. So the prescaler's effect on real-time tracking is checked indirectly, through interrupt timing.

The plan's stimulus ("switch prescaler at random times") is only loosely met, because the sequence writes the prescaler once before enabling the timer. I did not report that as a separate finding.
